entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Vishal Kumar Tiwary, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Shweta Singh, Addl.P.P
Order No.04 Dated- 13.09.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2.  The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Bandgaon(Keraikela) P.S. Case No. 28 of 2005, corresponding to G.R. Case No.209 of 2005 (Now, S.T. Case No.108 of 2020) registered under sections 376(2)(g) and 34 of Indian Penal Code.

3. As per FIR, allegation is that petitioner along with others has committed rape with the victim "X"
and when the sister of the victim rushed to rescue the victim, she was also threatened.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case due to inimical terms between the victim and the petitioner.
No such incidence has ever taken place rather the petitioner was falsely implicated in this case.
The victim has not been examined under section 164 of Cr.PC.
Charge-sheet has been submitted and charge has also been framed against the petitioner.
The victim is a married woman of 30 years old.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
The petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 02.02.2024 without any rhymes and reasons.

Hence the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
5.
Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record and period of custody of the petitioner, I am inclined to Suku Melgandi @ Sukhdev Melgandi vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154608077/
1 release the above named petitioner, on bail.

entities.text: Suku Melgandi @ Sukhdev Melgandi vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, West Singhbhum, at Chaibasa in connection with Bandgaon(Keraikela) P.S. Case No. 28 of 2005,
corresponding to G.R. Case No.209 of 2005 (Now, S.T. Case No.108 of 2020) with condition that petitioner shall appear physically on each and every date during the trial of case till its conclusion unless his physical appearance is dispensed with for sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the learned trial court and with further condition that petitioner shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
